name: tpl-response-1-nogoal~p1
task: At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a conditional rule ('At every moment the ball is out of the way of the door, you have to be carrying the key then, or pick it up later'), not an unconditional command, so Response(blocker_moved, has_door_key) hard alone is correct. 'Carrying the key then' is covered by Response's 'on that step or later' (both true on the same step pays no penalty in the machine), and 'or pick it up later' is covered by the owed obligation persisting until has_door_key occurs, matching the clue's wording exactly. blocker_moved is a lasting condition, and a Response on a lasting condition is the standard encoding. No Existence is demanded because the rule holds vacuously if the ball is never moved; the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are therefore valid.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key) -> u1
(u1, has_door_key) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, blocker_moved&!has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, has_door_key, u0) -> 1
